ideas.hook: Believe it or not, ancient Egyptians were brushing their teeth with crushed eggshells and pumice 5,000 years ago.
ideas.why: It leverages the 'surprising historical oddity' pattern seen in high-performing content by focusing on relatable, everyday hygiene in a bizarre ancient context.

ideas.topic: Why Egyptians Wore Eye Liner as Medicine
ideas.hook: That iconic dark eyeliner wasn't just for fashion; it was actually a life-saving medical treatment.
ideas.why: It taps into the aesthetic appeal of Ancient Egypt while providing a scientific fact that challenges common assumptions about their makeup.

ideas.topic: The Mystery of the Pharaoh's Missing Nose
ideas.hook: Why do almost all ancient Egyptian statues have their noses broken off?
ideas.why: This addresses a common visual question viewers have when looking at artifacts, utilizing the curiosity gap found in 'mystery/unboxing' style viral hits.
